DE has not booked any corresponding payable and there is no support to justify DE recording this liability. Recommend US either provide support (invoice/agreement) so DE can book its side, or reverse JE-00306 if it cannot be substantiated. Not booked on DE's books pending resolution.

args.text:
US–DE Intercompany Reconciliation — March 2026 Close

Starting position (per controller email DOC-0208, 4/1): US Intercompany Receivable (1400) = $10,450.00; DE Intercompany Payable (2300) = €7,800.00. Did not tie.

Analysis of US 1400 activity:
1. JE-00171 (2/20): IC recharge to DE, €7,800 @1.08 = $8,424 — invoice DOC-0125 (ICI-DE-01, software recharge). Already mirrored on DE's books via JE-00174 (Dr 6200 / Cr 2300, €7,800). Reconciled.
2. JE-00308 (3/31): $156 remeasurement of the €7,800 EUR-denominated receivable from 1.08 to 1.10 (Treasury policy rate, DOC-0204). This is a US-only monetary remeasurement entry (US reports in USD; the underlying EUR balance itself, €7,800, is unchanged). No DE-side entry is required — DE's payable is already stated in its own functional currency (EUR) and does not get remeasured. $8,424 + $156 = $8,580, i.e., €7,800 @1.10.
3. JE-00272 (3/18): IC recharge to DE, €500 @1.10 = $550 — invoice DOC-0190 (ICI-DE-02, CI/CD tooling seats recharge, March 2026). This was NOT yet booked on DE's books. Action taken: posted JE-00309 on DE (Dr 6200 Software Subscriptions €500 / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable €500), supported by DOC-0190.
4. JE-00306 (3/30): $1,320 "IC adj DE per call," posted manually by r.hale with NO supporting documentation attached (no invoice, agreement, or call notes located in the document store). This cannot be substantiated and has NOT been booked on DE's side. Flagged as EXC-001 for controller review — recommend either the US side obtain/attach proper support so DE can record it, or reverse JE-00306 if it cannot be substantiated.

Result:
- DE Intercompany Payable (2300) now = €8,300.00 (€7,800 + €500 booked), which ties out to all invoice-supported and FX-remeasured items on the US side: $8,580 + $550 = $9,130 = €8,300 @1.10.
- Remaining unreconciled/unsupported item: $1,320 (JE-00306) on US books — flagged as EXC-001, not mirrored on DE's books pending support or reversal.
- Checklist item "Intercompany reconciliation" (DE) marked complete, with the $1,320 exception called out separately for controller resolution.
